src: FishBase Cynoscion nebulosus lists depth "10 – ? m", which does not fit its known habitat; depth here from its estuarine/grass-flat habitat (0.5–3 m, winter holes to ~10 m) — medium-low confidence · https://fishbase.se/summary/Cynoscion-nebulosus.html
FWC spotted seatrout species profile (spawning spring–early fall in estuaries) · https://myfwc.com/wildlifehabitats/profiles/saltwater/seatrout/ (not re-read for this report)
Temperature range: judgment from its estuarine range (cold-kills below ~5 °C documented in Texas/Florida); not a FishBase field — low confidence
FishBase Mycteroperca microlepis: adults 30–160 m; juveniles in seagrass/estuaries (so min 1 m) · https://fishbase.se/summary/Mycteroperca-microlepis.html
Coleman et al. 1996, Env. Biol. Fish. 47: spawning Jan–Apr, peak Feb–Mar, shelf-edge aggregations (eastern Gulf)
FishBase Lutjanus griseus: depth 5–180 m; "spawning in summer near the full moon"; juveniles in mangroves/estuaries (so min 0 m) · https://fishbase.se/summary/Lutjanus-griseus.html
Domeier, Koenig & Coleman 1996; Allman & Grimes 2002 (Fish. Bull.): spawning Jun–Sep, peak Jul, Florida Keys/NE Gulf
FishBase Ocyurus chrysurus: reef-associated, depth 0–180 m; spawning year-round with regional peaks · https://fishbase.se/summary/Ocyurus-chrysurus.html
Muller, Murphy et al. 2003, FWC yellowtail snapper assessment: spawning Apr–Sep, peak May–Jul (Florida Keys)
Temperature: judgment (tropical reef fish; Keys cold-water stress <~18 °C) — low confidence
